The '''Scintilla Scavengers''' were a group of hostile droids that operated during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. They [[Mining/Legends|mined]] an [[Iron/Legends|iron]] [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid field]] in the [[Naboo system/Legends|Naboo system]] known as [[Scintilla Steel]], and, as with [[Iron Assembler/Legends|The Iron Assembler]], they attacked any [[Starship/Legends|starships]] that approached the [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] field.
